recommended_wording: MOSAIC-N achieved state-of-the-art or competitive fine-level closed-set performance across PBMC, COVID-19 CITE-seq, GSE164378, and COMBAT/COVID disease-shift benchmarks.
required_caveat: Use task-specific qualifiers; COVID full is ACC/W-F1 lead, GSE strongest row is fixed ensemble, COMBAT is parent-safe disease-shift.
forbidden_wording: MOSAIC-N is universally SOTA on every metric and every dataset.

recommended_wording: HSR is a hierarchy-aware sibling refinement head for targeted fine-level boundary repair after the base multimodal classifier.
required_caveat: Define it as sparse targeted refinement, not broad classifier replacement.
forbidden_wording: HSR solves open-set, missing-modality, and cross-dataset transfer by itself.

recommended_wording: On the full COVID-19 51-class protocol, MOSAIC-N RDV2 base led in ACC and weighted F1 under the no-subset full-scale split.
required_caveat: Macro F1 is caveated because RNA logistic has the highest macro F1.

recommended_wording: On GSE164378 exact-L3 53-class closed-set annotation, the fixed MOSAIC-N RDV2 3-seed majority ensemble was the strongest ACC row; validation-only single-model selection provided a small single-model caveat closure.
required_caveat: ASDC_pDC singleton excluded; single-model improvement is small.
forbidden_wording: 54-class full-label SOTA or large-margin single-model dominance.

recommended_wording: Boundary-level attribution, marker overlap, modality contribution, and HSR error-correction audits provide computational interpretability evidence, strongest for PBMC strict L3 boundaries.
required_caveat: Computational plausibility only; no wet-lab or independent expert signoff.
forbidden_wording: Causal marker discovery or complete biological validation.

recommended_wording: Historical MOSAIC MoE analyses are reported as supplementary context for expert specialization and non-uniform routing.
required_caveat: Do not use historical routing as current MOSAIC-N V16/V21/V22 main evidence.
